sentences.en: After three days of hiking, I was isolated in Senegal.
sentences.zh: 徒步旅行了三天后，我在塞内加尔感到很孤独。

sentences.en: Even though I enjoy hiking, I haven't gone hiking recently.
sentences.zh: 虽然我喜欢徒步旅行，但最近没去徒步过。

sentences.en: If it's raining, we don't plan to go hiking.
sentences.zh: 如果下雨的话，我们就不打算去远足了。

senses.zh: 远足，徒步旅行；拉起，提起（衣物）；把（价格等）大幅提高（hike 的现在分词）
